messages:
lia_csm: FYI — Helix staging cutover scheduled tomorrow 02:00 PST. Need final signoff on quota, autoscale policy, and load test window. Renewal flag: they want SLA before EOW. Quick checklist below.

ashley_se: Can you confirm quota numbers? last run used ~1.9k req/s; target peak is 2.5k with 10m burst, right?

simon_sre: yes. Proposed:
```
autoscale: min=10 pods
scale_metric: rps
target_rps_per_pod: 250
max=12 pods
burst_window: 10m
```
Also enable `prefix_cache=true` and `kv_cache_size=20GB` for warmup.

kevin_csm_manager: Renewal risk is medium-high if first 24h has errors. We should demo latency p95 < 120ms for 95% of requests. Capture failures to #incidents if any.

jordan_prod: Load test scheduled 01:00 PST (prep at 00:30). k6 script below to emulate traffic:
```
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 10m script.js --out influxdb=http://metrics:8086
```
We'll ramp: 500 -> 1500 -> 2500 over 30m.

maya_se: I'll own the smoke validation and data priming. Plan: run 50K prefix-caching priming requests starting at 00:40.

lia_csm: Perfect. Who's on-duty for rollback? @simon_sre?

simon_sre: I'll watch infra, @jordan_prod will watch API errors. Rollback plan: reduce traffic by 50% and re-route to fallback-small-model pool, then scale down to min and open ticket.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: redwood-deploy/helix-staging v2.3 -> started by @lia_csm

deploy-bot: smoke-tests passed (3/3). Canary at 10% ready.

ashley_se: Collect feedback: customer success checklist + short survey after 6h. I'll prepare one-pager.

kevin_csm_manager: Add a renewal flag to the account record: `renewal_risk=watch` and note: customer asked for cost numbers. Maya, can you capture cost delta for dedicated vs hosted?

maya_se: will do, sending numbers post-test.

lia_csm: final ask: keep thread updates short. Post failures as separate incident threads. :thumbsup:

simon_sre: copying runbook snippet:
```
if p95>250ms OR error_rate>0.5%:
  - pause ramp
  - scale to max
  - drop 50% traffic to fallback
  - notify #incidents
```

jordan_prod: All set on my side. See you at 00:30 PST. Good luck :rocket:

lia_csm: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with post-mortem template and the customer survey link.
